positions.name: ProbeMemoryPurpose
positions.frame: what role does a probe memory play in carrying an e2e suite's assertion about review enrollment?
positions.why: src-1 declares the e2e suite's assertion that saving a memory enrolls its creator as a reviewer; src-2 states this probe memory exists solely to carry that assertion. The two cohere under the read of what a probe memory is for in relation to the suite's enrollment claim — the first supplies the assertion, the second supplies the purpose.
